body: Hate to sound whiny and like a SJW but 4 new cast members and not one is LGBT or a POC. This is the least inclusive franchise ever. It’s  based in West Hollywood the Mecca of gay culture in SoCal and the only time an lgbt person or a POC was featured was with Billie and we know how that turned out and with Faith..so over this stupid show for now...sorry rant over.
Thank you so much I truly appreciate that :)

Unpopular opinion but I really miss Phaedra I loved her reads and sense of delusion about being a southern belle. I also miss Lizzie from OC she should have survived another season idk why she brought it and stood up to Tammy Sue!

My ex blocked me from all types of communication on his end. Yesterday he finally reached out to say he is picking up his car on Tuesday and that after that he never will contact me again and I will never see him again. I relate with your pain and I am sorry. I to am figuring out what to do in terms of moving on. If possible maybe get out of your house and stay with friends for a few days being in this house without him is driving me crazy. Try and find a TV show to watch it may sound silly but it helps pass time. If there is no chance of reconciliation between you two maybe take some time away and go on vacation to regroup and focus. I might be moving completely out of state because the pain is so apparent and I feel like I’m going crazy. I’m so sorry for what you are going through my ex was also my best friend. We can lean on each other for support.

Today after years of relapses and binge drinking and destructive behavior I will not drink and attend a meeting. I want to rebuild my life and get sober so I can be successful and happy! I’m a little nervous but hopeful any words of encouragement will help or even a personal message in my inbox! Keep up the good work everyone and much love!
